words.gram: pres. part. pass. √gṝ, m. nom. sg.

hindi: हे अग्नि, स्तुति किए जाते हुए तुम भोजन के लिए, हव्य अर्पण के लिए आओ; होता बनकर कुशासन पर बैठो।
english: Come, O Agni, being praised, to the feast, to the offering of the oblation; sit down as the Hotṛ priest on the sacred grass.
notes: ā ... yāhi: ā is the preverb of yāhi. vītaye is taken as 'for the feast/enjoyment (of the oblation)'. satsi is the Vedic imperative-like 2 sg. of ni-√sad. 'havya-dātaye' could also be read 'for the giving of the oblation (to the gods)'.

hindi: हे अग्नि, तुम सब यज्ञों के होता हो, देवों द्वारा मनुष्यों के बीच स्थापित किए गए।
english: You, O Agni, are the Hotṛ priest of all sacrifices, placed by the gods among the human people.
notes: '~' in yajñānā~, viśveṣā~ stands for the nasal (anusvāra) of the genitive plural -ām. 'hitaḥ ... devebhiḥ' is read as 'set by the gods'; 'among the gods' for devebhiḥ is not possible grammatically.

hindi: हम अग्नि को दूत के रूप में चुनते हैं, जो होता है, सब कुछ जाननेवाला है और इस यज्ञ का अत्यन्त कुशल है।
english: We choose Agni as messenger, the Hotṛ priest, the all-knowing, the very skilful one of this sacrifice.
notes: 'viśva-vedasam' can also mean 'possessing all wealth'; 'all-knowing' used. 'sukratum' with 'asya yajñasya' is read 'very skilful (in) this sacrifice'.

hindi: अग्नि, प्रज्वलित, तेजस्वी और आहुति पाया हुआ, धन की इच्छा करता हुआ, स्तुति के साथ शत्रुओं (बाधाओं) को मारे।
english: May Agni, kindled, bright and offered to, seeking wealth, strike the obstacles with admiring praise.
notes: 'draviṇasyuḥ' may also mean 'desiring to give wealth'. 'vṛtrāṇi' is taken as 'obstacles/foes' (plural of vṛtra). 'vipanyayā' is taken as 'with admiration/praise'.

words.gloss: to be gained, to be known

hindi: मैं तुम्हारे सबसे प्रिय अतिथि की स्तुति करता हूँ, प्रिय मित्र के समान; हे अग्नि, रथ के समान प्राप्त करने योग्य की।
english: I praise your dearest guest, like a dear friend; O Agni, like a chariot to be gained.
notes: 'vedyam' (√vid) is rendered 'to be gained'; 'to be known/valued' is also possible. 'vo' = vaḥ could be 'for you'; 'your' used. 'rathaṃ na vedyam' is read as a comparison continuing to qualify the guest.

hindi: हे अग्नि, तुम अपनी महान शक्तियों से हमें सब प्रकार की अदानशीलता से और मरणशील मनुष्य के द्वेष से बचाओ।
english: Protect us, O Agni, with your great powers, from all ill-will and from the hatred of the mortal.
notes: 'arāteḥ' can mean 'niggardliness' or 'hostility'; 'ill-will' used. 'viśvasyāḥ' is the reading restored before 'arāteḥ'.

hindi: आओ, हे अग्नि, मैं तुम्हें इस प्रकार दूसरी स्तुतियाँ कहूँ; तुम इन सोम-बूँदों से बढ़ो।
english: Come, O Agni; let me speak to you thus other songs; may you grow strong with these drops.
notes: 'ehyū' is read ehi + u (a form with y before u). 'itarā giraḥ' (other songs) with 'itthā' (thus). 'vardhāsaḥ' read as a 2 sg. subjunctive; 'indubhiḥ' = drops of Soma, as 'indu' commonly means. The verb forms 'ehi ... bravāṇi' are an invitation to come and hear.

hindi: वत्स तुम्हारे मन को सबसे ऊँचे निवास से भी खींच लाए; हे अग्नि, मैं स्तुति के द्वारा तुम्हें चाहता हूँ।
english: May Vatsa draw your mind hither even from the highest abode; O Agni, I desire you with a song.
notes: 'vatsaḥ' is taken as the name of the sage (Vatsa); 'calf/son' is also possible. 'ā ... yamat' = 'may he bring (here)'. 'sadhasthāt' = 'from the (common) place/abode'.

hindi: हे अग्नि, अथर्वा ने तुम्हें कमल से, प्रत्येक यजमान के सिर से मथकर निकाला।
english: Atharvan churned you forth, O Agni, from the lotus, from the head of every sacrificer.
notes: 'nir amanthata' = churned out. 'vāghat' is taken as 'sacrificer/priest'. 'mūrdhnaḥ' could be ablative or genitive ('head of'); 'puṣkarāt' 'lotus' could also be 'sky/water'; the plain meaning is used.

hindi: हे अग्नि, हमारी बड़ी सहायता के लिए तेजस्वी (धन) लाओ; क्योंकि तुम देव हो, हमारे देखने के लिए।
english: O Agni, bring us what is radiant for great help; for you are a god, for us to see.
notes: 'vivasvat' is taken as 'what is radiant' (the object of bhara); 'light' or 'brilliantly' are also possible. 'no dṛśe' = 'for our sight'.

hindi: हे अग्नि, तुम्हें नमस्कार है, तुम्हारे बल के लिए; हे देव, लोग तुम्हारी स्तुति करते हैं। अपनी शक्तियों से शत्रु को कुचल दो।
english: Homage to you, O Agni, for strength; O god, the peoples praise you. Crush the enemy with your powers.
notes: 'ojase' could also be read 'for/by (your) strength'. 'gṛṇanti' has no expressed object (understood: you).

hindi: तुम्हारे दूत को, जो सब कुछ जाननेवाला है, हव्य वहन करनेवाला है, अमर है और सबसे श्रेष्ठ यज्ञ करनेवाला है, मैं स्तुति से सजाता हूँ।
english: Your messenger, the all-knowing, the carrier of oblations, the immortal, the best sacrificer, I adorn with a song.
notes: 'ṛñjase' has the ending of the 2 sg. but is taken here in sense as 'I adorn/honour' (the person of the verb is doubtful; the sense follows the usual reading). 'vaḥ' = 'your/for you'.

words.gram: pres. part. intens. √diś, f. nom. pl.

hindi: यज्ञ की आहुति देनेवाले की बहनों जैसी स्तुतियाँ तुम्हारी ओर संकेत करती हुई वायु के आगे आ खड़ी हुई हैं।
english: The kindred songs of the maker of oblations, pointing to you, have taken their stand beside you, at the front of Vāyu.
notes: 'upa ... asthiran' = 'have stood near (you)'. 'haviṣkṛtaḥ' may be genitive singular (as translated) or nominative/accusative plural. 'vāyoḥ anīke' is rendered literally 'at the front of Vāyu'.

hindi: हे अग्नि, दिन-प्रतिदिन, रात और दिन, हम प्रार्थना के साथ नमस्कार लाते हुए तुम्हारे पास आते हैं।
english: To you, O Agni, day by day, night and day, with thought, bringing homage, we come.
notes: 'doṣāvastaḥ' is taken as 'night and day' (as an adverbial expression); other readings ('O illuminer of the night') exist. 'upa ... emasi' = 'we come near'.

hindi: हे स्तुति से जागनेवाले, उसे ध्यान में लो; प्रत्येक जन-समूह में यज्ञ के योग्य रुद्र के लिए देखने में सुन्दर स्तोत्र है।
english: O you who awaken to praise, attend to that: for Rudra, worthy of sacrifice in every clan, a hymn beautiful to behold.
notes: 'viviḍḍhi' is uncertain (taken as an imperative of √viś 'take notice/enjoy'). The sentence has no finite verb in the second line; 'is/(we offer)' is understood. 'viśeviśe yajñiyāya' could also be read as a single phrase 'for the sacrificial one in every clan'.

hindi: उस सुन्दर यज्ञ की ओर, गो-पान (दूध मिले सोमपान) के लिए तुम बुलाए जाते हो; हे अग्नि, मरुतों के साथ आओ।
english: To that lovely rite you are invoked, for the drinking; come, O Agni, with the Maruts.
notes: 'gopīthāya' is rendered 'for the drinking' (literally 'cow-drink', i.e. milk-mixed drink); the exact sense is traditional. 'prati ... pra hūyase' = 'you are called forth towards'.

words.gram: pres. part. sam-√rāj, m. acc. sg.

hindi: घोड़े के समान पूँछवाले तुम्हें, अग्नि को, नमस्कार के साथ स्तुति करने के लिए, जो यज्ञों का सम्राट बनकर शोभित है।
english: To praise you, Agni, like a horse with a tail, with homage, you who rule supreme over the rites.
notes: The line has no finite verb; the infinitive vandadhyai ('to praise') depends on an understood 'we come/are here'. 'vāravantam' (having a tail) with 'aśvaṃ na' is a comparison of uncertain point (the flame as a tail).

hindi: और्व, भृगु और अप्नवान के समान मैं उज्ज्वल अग्नि को, जिसका निवास समुद्र है, पुकारता हूँ।
english: Like Aurva and Bhṛgu and like Apnavāna, I call the bright Agni, whose dwelling is the sea.
notes: Aurva, Bhṛgu and Apnavāna are names (of sages). 'samudra-vāsasam' may also be 'clothed in the sea'; 'dwelling' used.

words.gram: pres. part. mid. √indh, m. nom. sg.

words.gloss: may he follow, may he attain

hindi: अग्नि को मन से प्रज्वलित करता हुआ मरणशील मनुष्य प्रार्थना को पाए; वह तेजस्वियों के साथ अग्नि को प्रज्वलित करता है।
english: The mortal, kindling Agni with his mind, may follow the prayer; he kindles Agni with the radiant ones.
notes: 'vivasvabhiḥ' is doubtful: 'with the radiant ones' (or 'with the devoted/worshipping ones'). 'dhiyaṃ saceta' = 'may he attend to/attain the prayer'; the sense is not secure.

hindi: तब वे पुरातन बीज की उस दैनिक ज्योति को देखते हैं, जो ऊपर आकाश में प्रज्वलित होती है।
english: Then indeed they see the daily light of the ancient seed, which is kindled on high in the sky.
notes: 'paraḥ' is taken as an adverb 'on high/beyond' with 'divi'. 'vāsaram' is an adjective 'daily/of the day' agreeing with jyotiḥ.

hindi: तुम्हारे अग्नि की ओर, जो यज्ञों में बढ़ता है, सबसे अधिक बहुरूप है, उस बलवान वंशज की ओर।
english: Towards your Agni, who grows among the rites, the most manifold, towards the mighty descendant.
notes: The verse has no finite verb (a verb such as 'go/come' is understood). 'vṛdhantam adhvarāṇām' may also be 'strengthening the rites'. 'naptre' = grandson/descendant (of strength); 'acchā' governs the datives as 'towards'.

hindi: अग्नि अपनी तीखी ज्वाला से हर भक्षक को नीचे दबा दे; अग्नि हमारे लिए धन जीत लाए।
english: May Agni with his sharp flame subdue every devourer; may Agni win wealth for us.
notes: In nyā3triṇam the figure 3 is a pluta (prolongation) mark inside ni-atriṇam, not translated. '~' marks the nasal anusvāra (yaṃsat, vaṃsate). 'atrin' = devourer (a class of foes).

hindi: हे अग्नि, कृपालु हो; तुम महान हो, जो देवों को चाहनेवाले जन के पास आते हो और कुशासन पर बैठने के लिए जाते हो।
english: O Agni, be gracious; you are great, you who go to the people devoted to the gods, to the sacred grass to sit.

text_flags.why: possible: the sense needs 'mahān asi' (you are great) and a relative 'yaḥ' before 'ā ... iyetha'; 'asyaya' looks like 'asi ya(ḥ)' run together

notes: 'asyaya' is kept as printed; the split asi + yaḥ is a reading by sense (flagged as possible). 'iyetha' = 'you come/go to' with accusative; 'barhir āsadam' = 'to sit on the grass'.

hindi: हे अग्नि, हमें संकट से बचाओ; हे देव, जो हमें हानि पहुँचाता है उसके विरुद्ध, हे अजर, अपनी सबसे तपानेवाली (ज्वालाओं) से जला दो।
english: O Agni, protect us from distress; O god, ageless one, burn against the one who would harm us with your hottest (flames).
notes: 'tapiṣṭhaiḥ' has no noun expressed (flames/rays understood). 'prati ... daha' = 'burn against/in return'. 'rakṣā' is rakṣa with Vedic lengthening.

hindi: हे अग्नि, अपने उन अश्वों को जोतो, हे देव, जो भले और तेज़ हैं और भली-भाँति ढोते हैं।
english: O Agni, yoke those horses of yours, O god, the good ones, which, swift, carry readily.
notes: 'yuṅkṣvā' is yuṅkṣva with Vedic lengthening. 'aram' = fittingly, readily.

hindi: हे प्रजाओं के स्वामी, पास आकर हम तुम्हें, तेजस्वी और उत्तम वीरों वाले को, स्थापित करते हैं; हे अग्नि, हे आहुति पाए हुए।
english: Approaching (you), O lord of the clans, we set down you, the radiant one, rich in good heroes, O Agni to whom oblations are offered.
notes: 'nakṣya' is uncertain (taken as a form of √nakṣ 'approach/reach'; Vedic readings differ). 'ni ... dhīmahe' = 'we establish/set (you) down'.

hindi: अग्नि द्युलोक का सिर और शिखर है, और पृथ्वी का स्वामी है; यह जलों के बीजों को जीवन देता है।
english: Agni is the head and the summit of heaven, and the lord of the earth; this one quickens the seeds of the waters.
notes: 'divaḥ kakut' is read 'summit of heaven'. 'pṛthivyāḥ ayam' with the visarga lost before the vowel.

hindi: हे अग्नि, तुम हमारी इस नई गायत्र स्तुति को, इस दान को, देवों के बीच भली-भाँति घोषित करो।
english: Declare well among the gods, O Agni, this newest gāyatra song of ours, this gift.
notes: 'saniṃ' is read as a noun in apposition 'gain/gift'; 'gāyatram' as 'gāyatra song'. 'navyāṃsam' is the comparative/superlative of navya 'new'.

hindi: उस तुम को, हे अग्नि, हे अंगिरस, गोपवन ने स्तुति से प्रकट किया है; वह तुम, हे पावक, हमारी पुकार सुनो।
english: Gopavana has brought you forth with a song, O Agni, O Aṅgiras; as that one, O purifier, hear our call.

text_flags.why: possible: Agni is addressed as Aṅgiras ('O Aṅgiras'); 'aṅgaraḥ' is not a known word

notes: 'janiṣṭhat' is uncertain (taken as a form of √jan, 'has caused to be born/brought forth'; 'has extolled' is possible). 'gopavanaḥ' is read as a personal name. 'aṅgaraḥ' is kept as printed.

hindi: शक्ति के स्वामी, कवि अग्नि हव्यों के चारों ओर गया है, और दानी (यजमान) को रत्न देता हुआ।
english: Agni, the lord of strength, the seer, has gone around the oblations, bestowing treasures on the giver.
notes: 'pari ... akramīt' = 'has gone around/travelled over'. 'vāja' = strength/prize (glossary).

hindi: उस जातवेदा देव को, सूर्य को, सब के देखने के लिए किरणें ऊपर उठा ले जाती हैं।
english: The rays carry up that god Jātavedas, the sun, for all to see.
notes: 'jātavedasam' and 'sūryam' are both accusatives qualifying 'tyaṃ devam'; 'ketavaḥ' = rays (or banners).

hindi: यज्ञ में कवि अग्नि की स्तुति करो, जिसके नियम सच्चे हैं, उस देव की, जो कष्ट को दूर भगानेवाला है।
english: At the rite praise Agni the seer, whose ordinances are true, the god who drives away affliction.
notes: 'amīvā' = affliction/trouble (a general word, no specific sense). 'upa stuhi' = 'praise (in his presence)'.

hindi: दिव्य देवियाँ हमारे लिए सहायता के निमित्त कल्याणकारी हों, पीने के लिए कल्याणकारी हों; वे सुख और कल्याण के साथ हमारी ओर बहें।
english: May the goddesses be a blessing for us, for our aid; may they be a blessing for our drinking; may they flow towards us with welfare and well-being.
notes: The text does not name the goddesses (devīḥ); no noun is supplied. 'śaṃ yoḥ' is the pair 'welfare and well-being'. 'abhiṣṭaye' = 'for aid / for what we wish'.

words.gram: n. loc. sg. (or verb form, uncertain)

hindi: हे सज्जनों के स्वामी, अब तुम किसके (यज्ञ में) प्रचुरता से प्रार्थनाओं को प्रेरित करते हो? जिसकी स्तुतियाँ तुम्हें प्रिय हैं।
english: Whose prayers do you now quicken in abundance, O lord of the good, whose songs are pleasing to you?
notes: 'parīṇasi' and 'joṣātā' are uncertain forms: parīṇasi is taken as 'in abundance' (or a verb 'you surround'); joṣātā as a form of √juṣ ('be pleased with'). The sense of the second line is a best reading and not secure.

hindi: प्रत्येक यज्ञ में और प्रत्येक स्तुति से तुम्हारे लिए, कुशल अग्नि के लिए, हम अमर जातवेदा को, मित्र के समान प्रिय को, आगे बढ़कर घोषित करें।
english: At every sacrifice and with every song, for you, for the skilful Agni, let me proclaim forth the immortal Jātavedas, dear like a friend.
notes: 'vayam' (we) with 'śaṃsiṣam' (1 sg.) is as printed; translated 'let me proclaim'. 'vaḥ' is 'for you' (plural). The unit is a longer verse (second line has three short pādas); no regrouping needed.

hindi: हे अग्नि, एक (स्तुति) से हमारी रक्षा करो और दूसरी से रक्षा करो; हे शक्तियों के स्वामी, तीन स्तुतियों से रक्षा करो, हे वसु, चार से रक्षा करो।
english: Protect us, O Agni, with one, and protect with the second; protect with three songs, O lord of strengths; protect with four, O good one.
notes: In pāhyū3ta the figure 3 is a pluta mark in pāhi + uta (not translated). 'ekayā', 'dvitīyayā' have no noun expressed (songs, understood from gīrbhiḥ).

words.gram: pres. part. pass. sam-√idh, m. nom. sg.

hindi: हे अग्नि, अपनी बड़ी ज्वालाओं से और उज्ज्वल तेज से, हे देव, भरद्वाज में प्रज्वलित होते हुए, हे सबसे युवा, हे पावक, धनपूर्ण होकर चमको।
english: With your great flames, O Agni, with your bright blaze, O god, being kindled in Bharadvāja, O youngest, O purifier, shine richly.
notes: Bharadvāja is a name (of a sage or his family); 'in Bharadvāja' is literal. 'revat' is taken as 'richly' (adverb).

hindi: हे सुन्दर आहुति पाए अग्नि, तुममें ये संरक्षक प्रिय हों, जो जनों के उदार नियन्ता हैं और गायों का समूह बाँटते हैं।
english: In you, O well-invoked Agni, may the patrons be dear: the bountiful controllers of the people, who distribute a herd of cows.
notes: 'tve' = 'in you' (in your regard); 'ūrvam' is taken as 'herd/fold' (accusative) with 'gonām' 'of cows'. 'yantāraḥ' could also be 'restrainers/rulers'.

words.gram: pres. part. mid. √tap, m. nom. sg.

hindi: हे अग्नि, हे स्तोता, हे प्रजाओं के स्वामी, हे देव, राक्षसों को जलाते हुए; हे घर के स्वामी, तुम कभी दूर न जानेवाले, महान, द्युलोक के रक्षक और घर की रक्षा करनेवाले हो।
english: O Agni, O praiser, lord of the clans, O god, burning the demons; ever-present, O master of the house, you are great, the protector of heaven, the guardian of the house.
notes: 'jaritaḥ' (O praiser/singer) is strange as an address to Agni and may be a different word in the underlying text; 'tapānaḥ' read as a participle of √tap. 'aproṣivān' = 'who has not gone away'. 'duroṇayuḥ' = 'attending/guarding the house' is uncertain.

hindi: हे अग्नि, हे अमर, उषा की चमकती हुई उज्ज्वल देन को लाओ; हे जातवेदा, तुम आज दानी के पास उन देवों को लाओ जो उषा के समय जागते हैं।
english: O Agni, O immortal, bring the shining, brilliant bounty of the dawn; O Jātavedas, bring to the giver today the gods who awake at dawn.
notes: 'vahā' is vaha lengthened; the first 'ā' of the second line goes with 'vahā' (ā ... vaha 'bring hither'). 'vivasvat' is taken as 'shining', agreeing with rādhaḥ.

hindi: हे उज्ज्वल, हे वसु, तुम सहायता के साथ हमारे लिए उपहार प्रेरित करो; हे अग्नि, तुम इस धन के रथी हो; हमारी सन्तान के लिए सहारा (घाट) पाओ।
english: O brilliant one, O good one, urge bounties on to us with your help; O Agni, you are the charioteer of this wealth; find a firm footing for our offspring.
notes: 'rāyaḥ' = rayiḥ 'of wealth' (genitive); 'rathīḥ' as 'charioteer/leader'. 'gādham' = ford, a place to stand in water, i.e. firm footing. 'tuce naḥ' = 'for our offspring'. vidā: 'find' (glossary).

words.gloss: they seek to win, they worship

hindi: तुम ही सर्वत्र फैले हुए हो, हे अग्नि, हे रक्षक; तुम सच्चे कवि हो। हे प्रज्वलित, हे दीप्तिमान, तुम्हें प्रेरित कवि और भक्त जन पूजते हैं।
english: You indeed are widespread, O Agni, O protector, true seer; the inspired singers, the devout, worship you, O kindled one, O shining one.
notes: 'trātar-ṛtaḥ' is split trātaḥ + ṛtaḥ (visarga to r before ṛ). 'vivāsanti' = 'they seek to win/honour'; the root analysis is not firm (√van 'win' or ā-√vas). 'saprathāḥ' = 'widely extended'.

hindi: हे अग्नि, हे पावक, हमारे लिए बल बढ़ानेवाला, प्रशंसनीय धन लाओ; और हे समीप रहनेवाले, उत्तम नेतृत्व से हमें बहुत वांछित, अत्यन्त यशस्वी (धन) दो।
english: Bring to us, O Agni, O purifier, praiseworthy wealth that increases vigour; and give us, O near one, much-desired, most glorious (wealth) by good leading.
notes: 'upamāte' is uncertain (taken as a vocative 'O one near at hand'); 'vayovṛdham' = increasing vigour/life or food. 'sunītī' = by good guidance. The noun 'wealth' is understood for the second line.

hindi: जो सब धन बाँटता है, जो जनों में आनन्द देनेवाला होता है, उसके लिए मधु के प्रथम पात्रों की भाँति स्तोत्र अग्नि को अर्पित हों।
english: He who distributes all goods, the Hotṛ priest, gladdening among the people — to him, like the first cups of honey, may hymns be offered forth to Agni.
notes: 'madhor na pātrā prathamāni' = 'like the first cups of honey'. 'pra ... yantu' = 'let them be offered/go forth'. 'janānām' is read 'among/of the people'.

hindi: इस नमस्कार से मैं तुम्हारे लिए अग्नि को, बल के पुत्र को, पुकारता हूँ; उस प्रिय, अत्यन्त सावधान, सेवक, उत्तम यज्ञवाले, सबके दूत, अमर को।
english: With this homage I call for you Agni, the offspring of strength, the dear, most attentive, the attendant, of good rites, the immortal messenger of all.
notes: 'svādhvaram' keeps a long ā as printed; read su-adhvaram. 'ūrjo napātam' = 'offspring (grandson) of strength'. 'aratim' = attendant/minister (traditional sense). 'vaḥ' = 'for you'.

hindi: तुम वनों में, माताओं में लेटे रहते हो; मनुष्य तुम्हें प्रज्वलित करते हैं। अथक होकर तुम हव्य-कर्ता के लिए हव्य ले जाते हो, तब देवों में चमकते हो।
english: You lie in the woods, in the mothers; mortals kindle you. Unwearied, you carry the oblation for the maker of oblations; then indeed you shine among the gods.
notes: 'mātṛṣu' (in the mothers) is rendered literally; the text does not say who the mothers are. 'saṃ ... indhate' = 'they kindle'. 'haviṣkṛta' = haviṣkṛte (e + ā → a ā).

hindi: वह मार्ग खोजने में सर्वश्रेष्ठ दिखाई दिया है, जिसमें लोगों ने अपने व्रत रखे हैं; हमारी स्तुतियाँ आर्य को बढ़ानेवाले नवजात अग्नि के पास भली-भाँति पहुँचें।
english: He who is the best finder of the way has been seen, in whom they have placed their ordinances; may our songs approach well the newborn Agni, the increaser of the noble one.
notes: 'upo ṣu' = upa u su. 'vardhanam āryasya' = 'the increaser of the noble (Ārya)' – the term āryasya is not further identified. The subject of 'ādadhuḥ' (they) is not named.

hindi: उक्थ (स्तोत्र) में अग्नि आगे स्थापित है; यज्ञ में पत्थर और कुशासन (तैयार) हैं। हे प्रार्थना के स्वामी, मैं ऋचा से मरुतों के पास जाता हूँ; देवों की वरणीय सहायता।
english: Agni is placed in front at the recitation; the pressing stones and the sacred grass are at the rite. With a verse I go to the Maruts, O lord of the prayer; the gods' desirable help.
notes: Read as given, the verse lacks verbs in its first half and the second half is elliptical ('devāḥ avaḥ vareṇyam' read as 'the gods' desirable help'). 'brahmaṇaspate' is taken as a vocative 'O lord of prayer'. The construction is uncertain.

hindi: सहायता के लिए गीतों से अग्नि की स्तुति करो, जिसकी ज्वाला तीखी है। धन के लिए प्रसिद्ध अग्नि को, हे पुरुमीढ; मनुष्य अग्नि को, उत्तम दीप्ति के लिए आश्रय को।
english: Praise Agni for help with songs, him of keen flame. Famed Agni for wealth, O Purumīḍha; the men, Agni, for good shining, shelter.
notes: The second line is elliptical and its construction is uncertain: 'agniṃ rāye ... śrutam' (famed Agni, for wealth), 'naraḥ agniḥ sudītaye chardiḥ' (the men / Agni / for good shining / shelter). 'śīra-śociṣam' is uncertain ('keen/swift flame'). 'purumīḍha' is taken as a name or epithet in the vocative.

hindi: हे अग्नि, हे सुनने वाले कानों वाले, वाहक और साथ चलनेवाले देवों के साथ सुनो; यज्ञ में प्रातःकाल आनेवालों के साथ मित्र और अर्यमा कुशासन पर बैठें।
english: Hear, O Agni of the listening ear, with the gods, the bearers who go together; at the rite may Mitra and Aryaman sit on the sacred grass with those who come early.
notes: 'sīdatu' is singular though Mitra and Aryaman are two (agrees with the nearer). 'vahnibhiḥ devaiḥ' is read as one phrase; 'sayāvabhiḥ' = 'going together' is a traditional gloss.

hindi: दैवोदास अग्नि देव, इन्द्र के समान अपने बल से आगे बढ़ा; उसने माता पृथ्वी के साथ-साथ घूमकर आकाश के आश्रय में स्थान लिया।
english: Forth, Agni the god of Divodāsa, like Indra in might, has turned about along mother Earth and has stood in the shelter of the vault of heaven.
notes: 'daivodāsaḥ' read as 'of Divodāsa' (the patronymic adjective); the exact relation is not certain. 'pra' is taken with 'vi vāvṛte' (forth/abroad).

hindi: चाहे पृथ्वी से, चाहे द्युलोक से, महान प्रकाशमय लोक से; इस शरीर और स्तुति के साथ बढ़ो; हे सुबुद्धि, मेरी सन्तानों को पूर्ण करो।
english: Whether from the earth or from heaven, from the great luminous realm; grow with this body and this song; O very wise one, fill my offspring.
notes: 'mamā jātā' is uncertain: 'mamā' is taken as 'mama' (my) and 'jātā' as 'offspring/things born'. The first line has no verb of its own and is read as qualifying the second ('from earth or heaven grow ...'). 'bṛhato rocanād adhi' = 'from the great luminous realm'.

words.gram: pres. part. mid. √kā, m. nom. sg.

hindi: वनों की कामना करते हुए जब तुम माताओं, जलों के पास गए; हे अग्नि, तुम्हारा वह लौटना भुलाया नहीं जा सकता, कि दूर रहते हुए भी तुम यहाँ आ गए।
english: Desiring the woods, when you went to the mothers, the waters; that return of yours, O Agni, is not to be forgotten, that, being far away, you were here.
notes: 'mātṝḥ apaḥ' = 'the mothers, the waters' (apposition). 'pramṛṣe' is taken as a dative infinitive 'to be forgotten/overlooked'. 'ajagan' may be 2 sg. or 3 sg.; 2 sg. taken with 'tvam'.

hindi: हे अग्नि, मनु ने तुम्हें सब जनों के लिए ज्योति के रूप में स्थापित किया है; हे ऋत से उत्पन्न, सींचे हुए, तुम कण्वों के बीच चमके, जिसकी लोग वन्दना करते हैं।
english: Manu has set you down, O Agni, as a light for the people everywhere; you shone among the Kaṇvas, O one born of truth, sprinkled, whom the peoples revere.
notes: 'kaṇva' is read as the locative kaṇve (e + ṛ → a ṛ) 'among the Kaṇvas'; 'kaṇva' as a nominative name is also possible. 'śaśvate' = every / constantly; 'people everywhere' used. 'ukṣitaḥ' = sprinkled (with ghee, by tradition).
